message: C3 engine had no production caller; rollback story vacuous; shards d/t could never render outside tests.
resolution: runSchedulerHook wired at the plan->implement seam in lifecycle.ts (flag-gated, try/catch degrade); detectErrorCascadeSignatures called by executeShardPlan post-execution with report.cascadeSignatures. Test 73 drives the real transition both flag ways.

message: No failure-triggered global re-plan; misleading comment about failures adding usage data.
resolution: failureSinceReplan triggers a cadence-guarded replanUnstarted on shard_failed; comment corrected (failures never enter the cost model). Test 79.

message: A single telemetry sample flipped conservative_fallback to full HEFT; unrelated-role samples 'calibrated' the dispatch role.
resolution: MIN_COST_SAMPLES=2 per dispatch role required before leaving conservative_fallback; replanUnstarted returns previous under thin telemetry. Test 74.

message: Cascade monitor conflated plans/cycles (episodes keyed by bare shardId).
resolution: Episodes and consumers keyed by (planId, cycle, shardId); non-matching events skipped; settle events carry cycle. Test 75.

message: Contract-only edges oriented by partition order could invert true flow and gate readiness wrongly.
resolution: ShardDagEdge.kind distinguishes dependsOn vs contract; readiness gate uses dependsOn edges only; contract edges still feed rank hand-off costs. Test 76.

message: Usage counters never validated; poisoned telemetry skewed ranks.
resolution: usableUsage() guard skips non-finite/negative records in buildCostModel. Test 77.

message: Claim dedupe key ignored cycle despite docstring.
resolution: Dedupe/find keys are (planId, cycle, shardId) in record methods and replay handlers; events carry cycle. Test 71 extended.

message: Orphan shard_completed/failed events appended with no matching claim.
resolution: recordShardFinished skips the event when no claim exists; executor build-error path claims-then-fails to preserve claimed->settled shape. Test 71.

message: No crash reconciliation for claims stuck in claimed.
resolution: reconcileRunningSubagents extended: claimed claims whose taskId was reconciled are failed with process_restart via hash-chained shard_failed. Test 78.
Empty candidates/shortlist yield conservative fallback with stated reason (never a bare TypeError). Test 74.

message: No exception containment around the dispatch body.
resolution: dispatchShard wrapped in try/catch; any throw settles that shard as shard_failed (claim-then-fail if pre-claim) without aborting siblings.
Module header documents: only the failed shard's re-completion or merge_verified heals; a consumer's own clean completion deliberately does not.
